sections.title: Rissanen's structural and numerical parameter arguments

missing_pieces.duty: assessment_dispute: ED26-METHOD-minimum-description-length-C02 partial: U_R is defined (l.255-258), but the body never states that the selected structure minimizes it over the candidate orders, as source (4.10) on p.471 does. The method (l.297) says only 'Compare the published score'.

assessment_dispute: ED26-METHOD-minimum-description-length-C03 partial: neither minimization step from the source is stated as the estimator. The first is that the numerical parameters minimize the profiled length (4.6) (p.470). The second is that the structure minimizes (4.10) (p.471). l.230 and l.292-293 give only 'stationary fit' and 'fit ... using the declared length surrogate'.
assessment_dispute: C01, C04 and C05 are covered (l.32-41, 100-120, 189-209; l.126-152, 229-288, 306-315; l.340-362 with annex l.197-219). The source was checked at pp.468, 470 and 471.
